title: Honour Idempotency-Key on transfer creation
author: tunde.o
description:
Clients retry `POST /v1/transfers` on timeouts, and a retry that lands after the first request succeeded moves the money twice.

With this change a request that carries an `Idempotency-Key` header returns the transfer created earlier with the same key instead of creating a second one (200 instead of 201). Keys are scoped to the source account. Requests without the header behave exactly as before.

Migration 0002 adds the nullable `idempotency_key` column and a partial unique index on `(from_account, idempotency_key)`.
ask: What happens when two requests with the same Idempotency-Key arrive at the same time?
What status code does a replayed request get?
